correctness.rationale: Full ordinary forcing iff is proved from two nonforcing obstructions (white cycle and no isolated vertex) and a constructive leaf-and-fixed-isolate forcing process. Cayley/forest component enumeration, isolate inclusion-exclusion, formal generating function and exact minimum-set count follow with their n=2 boundary handled. Independent forcing simulations versus DSU forest/isolate tests pass for all 33,866 initial sets at n=2..6 plus 20,480 deterministic samples at n=7..11; recurrence coefficients and extremal formulas checked. Computation is supportive, not the infinite proof. Details in RESULT.md and verify.py.

value.rationale: The structural equivalence solves a complete natural enumeration question for an entire standard graph family, supplying every zero-forcing-set coefficient, a formal two-parameter generating function, a finite polynomial recurrence, and exact multiplicities of minimum sets. The historical scalar Z and classical Cayley count do not imply the novel all-set characterization or its full graph polynomial. This is meaningful graph-enumeration content rather than a narrow computation or arbitrary slice.
